build_MViT_model: build a MViT multiscale vision transformer model from a config object for image classification
create_PatchEmbed_module: create a PatchEmbed module that convolves input and flattens to B HW C sequence format
create_TransformerBasicHead: create a TransformerBasicHead classification layer with linear projection and softmax or sigmoid activation
run_MViT_forward: run the MViT forward pass on a batch of images to get classification logits
review_prepare_mvit_configs: review the _prepare_mvit_configs function that computes dim_mul, head_mul, and pooling stride factors from config
